items.title: Trump’s healthcare plans under contention after Democrats’ midterm landslide
items.summary: Experts note that Democrats are likely to place Trump’s MFN deals under the microscope and vie to reverse sweeping Medicaid cuts following the midterm results.

items.title: Boehringer signs oncology deal with Sino Biopharm worth up to $7.4bn
items.summary: The collaboration will focus on antibody-drug conjugate (ADC) and T-cell engager (TCE) technologies across six programmes.

items.title: AbbVie bolsters UK R&D presence, inks $1.38bn IBD deal with Nxera
items.summary: AbbVie will use the Oxford site to advance treatments for immunological, neurological and oncological diseases.

items.title: GEBRO and Spektus sign collaboration for ActraFlex
items.summary: GEBRO Holding and Spektus Pharma have agreed a global commercialisation partnership for ActraFlex, an extended-release pain management therapy taken twice daily.
